Title: CIA-UAP-D001 Intelligence Information Report - USSR (1973)
Description Blurb: CIA Intelligence Information Report on a UAP incident in the USSR, 1973. Three pages, scan of a classified document with the standard 'not finally evaluated intelligence' header.

Title: DOE-UAP-D001 Pantex Unidentified Object Incident Report (Image)
Description Blurb: Department of Energy / NNSA Pantex Plant incident report — ground surveillance radar tower image plus a Sandia National Labs enhanced image of the object. UCNI markings throughout.

Title: DOE-UAP-D002 James Tuck Correspondence
Description Blurb: DOE correspondence concerning Dr. James Tuck and large atmospheric vortices produced by simulated atomic detonations — referenced against the COMETA-era 'Scientific Study of UFOs' literature. Four pages, typewritten with redactions.

Title: DOE-UAP-D003 Pajarito Astronomers Meeting Notice (1986)
Description Blurb: Pajarito Astronomers (Los Alamos NM) meeting notice for May 29, 1986. Guest speaker Dr. John Warren of AT-6: 'Why Should a Scientist be Concerned about UFO's?' Single page, mimeographed bulletin.

Title: DOW-UAP-D017 General Correspondence Of Sandia
Description Blurb: Large (116-page) collection of Sandia Base security correspondence dating to 1949 — guard orders, security inspections, and related administrative records around the early atomic-era flying-disc reports.

Title: ODNI-UAP-D001 USPER Narrative — Senior USIC
Description Blurb: First-person narrative by a senior US intelligence officer describing a late-2025 helicopter mission investigating loud thuds and orb-like UAP sightings over a military test range.
